### Added
- **Spans name the backend of a tool call.** A call through `call_tool` set `mcp.tool.name=call_tool` on muster's spans and no tool name on the client span to the backend, so a trace could not be filtered by backend tool or server. The client span to the backend now carries `gen_ai.tool.name` (the backend-native tool name, from the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions for MCP) and `mcpserver.name`; the inbound `mcp.tools/call` server span and the `tool.<tool>` span carry `mcpserver.name` and `muster.downstream.tool.name` (the exposed name, as in `muster_downstream_tool_calls{tool}`), and `mcp.tool.name` still names the invoked tool. A `workflow.step` span is labelled by its own dispatch; the workflow's server span is not. ([giantswarm/giantswarm#36711](https://github.com/giantswarm/giantswarm/issues/36711))
